answer: Staked curation blocks a gale of fakes: an identity earns nothing until a curator stakes 40 credits on it, locked until close. The k-th fake needs a k-th stake, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits, and a proven sybil cluster burns every bond its curator posted. Auditors trace the karst funding trail; shared funders or reused credentials trigger a re-check that burns the bond and freezes the identities. Renting curators fails because a rented curator still risks its timber bond per identity and cannot reuse one bond. An honest identity needs one stake, refunded after passing.
